title: New radiocarbon dates of human tooth enamel reveal a late appearance of farming life in the Indus Valley
version: Scientific Reports 15, 11345, DOI 10.1038/s41598-025-92621-5. Author list abbreviated.
lineage: Primary radiocarbon measurements on human tooth enamel, independent of earlier morphometric analyses of cattle bones.

passages.note: The revised start range concerns the Period I cemetery, based on modelled human tooth enamel dates. Zebu domestication soon after settlement is the authors’ interpretation.
